description: SPD DG Connections Network Info is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The "SPD DG Connections Network Info" data table provides network capacity information, network reinforcement requirements and estimated connection dates, based on generation and storage resources that are connected, or accepted to connect to the SP Energy Network's SP Distribution (SPD) network. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Asset Data. Its keywords are Generation, SPD, 33kV, Constraint, Capacity, LMS. The portal shows 2025-10-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
